text:
Tanvi (support): FYI customer Greenfield just opened an escalation — they see unexpected KMS decrypt calls and admin API activity from a service account in their Dedicated VPC. Asking for immediate containment and log pull. timeframe: 2025-06-14 02:00-09:00 UTC. sample request id: req_8f3b2a.
Alex (eng-security): on it. Can you DM tenant id and the compromised service-account name? We'll start a read-only snapshot of audit logs.
Ravi (eng-platform): tagging @Alex, I'll prepare an RBAC deny and temporary KMS policy to block decrypts for that key. Which key id?
Tanvi (support): DM'd tenant id gf-prod and service-account greenfield-svc-01. Key id is kms-key-9a7f. Customer says they rotated the service-account keys yesterday at 02:14 UTC but logs show decrypts at 08:05 UTC from 52.148.12.9.
Ravi (eng-platform): applied temporary deny policy on tenant gf-prod and the key. Commands used:
```
# deny decrypt for the key for the service-account
redwoodctl iam update-policy --tenant gf-prod --policy '{"Statement":[{"Effect":"Deny","Action":"kms:Decrypt","Principal":"svc:greenfield-svc-01","Resource":"kms:kms-key-9a7f"}]}'
# block outbound to suspicious IP at vpc egress
redwoodctl network update-egress --tenant gf-prod --drop-sources 52.148.12.9
```
Tanvi (support): customer confirmed the IP is not in their allowlist. They requested copies of any logs that show data exfil attempts.
Lina (observability): pulled control-plane audit logs and KMS provider logs for timeframe. Sample from audit stream: 
```
2025-06-14T08:05:12Z tenant=gf-prod req=req_8f3b2a principal=svc:greenfield-svc-01 action=kms:Decrypt resource=kms-key-9a7f src_ip=52.148.12.9 bytes_out=0
2025-06-14T08:05:13Z tenant=gf-prod req=req_8f3b2b principal=svc:greenfield-svc-01 action=admin:CreateApiKey resource=service-api src_ip=52.148.12.9
```
Lina (observability): forwarding full logs to the secure incident bucket now (s3://redwood-incidents/gf-prod/1754001234).
Alex (eng-security): good catch. Two asks: 1) preserve forensic snapshot of the dedicated node images and flow logs, 2) rotate any remaining service-account tokens and create new keys under a different principal.
Ravi (eng-platform): started packet capture and VPC flow logs, forwarded to SIEM. Also created a read-only snapshot of the dedicated instance.
Jordan (csm): I'm drafting initial customer comms: will confirm containment actions (RBAC deny, KMS block, key rotation), provide log excerpts and ask them to rotate their app credentials and rotate any upstream keys. Will ask for confirmation whether PII was present.
Tanvi (support): customer asked whether this could be due to misconfigured RBAC after yesterday's key rotation.
Alex (eng-security): possible. We'll review RBAC change events around 02:14 UTC. Lina, grep for policy-change events in control-plane logs for that timeframe.
Lina (observability): found policy update by ops-user: ops-jenk at 2025-06-14T02:15:03Z: `iam:UpdateRole` touching greenfield-svc-01 — attaching snippet.
Tanvi (support): forwarding that to the customer. They want timeline and a list of what we changed.
Ravi (eng-platform): logged all containment actions in the incident runbook: INC-2025-0926. Actions: RBAC deny applied, KMS deny applied, VPC egress block, packet capture enabled, audit logs exported, forensic snapshot taken.
Alex (eng-security): next steps: full forensic analysis of snapshot, compare artifact hashes to known build, check for unauthorized binaries, review all admin-token activity, and run vulnerability scan on the dedicated image. Also add alert rule: alert when kms:Decrypt rate from single principal > 3/min.
Jordan (csm): I will coordinate customer comms + legal with Tanvi. Sending initial note now and will paste copy here once sent.
Tanvi (support): customer asked for ETA on service restoration — we told them we can keep service degraded while we forensically examine nodes; full restore ETA ~6-8 hours pending analysis.
Alex (eng-security): filing incident postmortem owner and brief: owner=Alex, timeline start=1754001234, affected=gf-prod dedicated tenant, severity=high.
Tanvi (support): thanks team. Please add any additional evidence to the incident bucket. I'll keep the customer updated in 30m. :thumbsup:
